rule: A live control keeps its expected label unless hard evidence on stock macOS shows the label is wrong; when the request is ambiguous or the behaviour cannot be established, the control is contested and excluded from the per-batch gate but still requires a verdict.
basis: Judged from the frozen request/command with man pages and read-only probes on this Mac; no campaign verdict used.

controls.request: delete every .DS_Store file in this folder and everything under it
controls.rationale: BSD find needs a path before the expression; verified it exits with "illegal option -- n".

controls.request: show notes.txt in all caps
controls.rationale: echo with command substitution collapses line breaks and spacing.

controls.request: take a screenshot and save it as shot.png
controls.rationale: -P opens the capture in Preview, an unrequested side effect.

controls.request: Show entries marked ERROR or WARN in app.log.
controls.rationale: Reads ~/app.log, not the local app.log the request names.

controls.request: how many files are in this folder?
controls.rationale: Recursively counts every file under the folder, not files in this folder; newline-delimited paths also overcount.

controls.request: delete every .DS_Store file in this folder and everything under it
controls.rationale: Same missing starting path; the command errors before deleting anything.

controls.request: Inspect MyApp.app's signing identity and signature details.
controls.rationale: Plain codesign -d omits the signing authority; only -dvv shows the identity, so the request is only half answered.

controls.request: Count the lines containing ERROR in the local app.log.
controls.rationale: Reads local/app.log (a subdirectory), not the local app.log the request names.

controls.request: show notes.txt in all caps
controls.rationale: Command substitution collapses line breaks and echo collapses spacing, so the file is not shown as-is.

controls.request: Which processes have UDP sockets open? Give numeric addresses.
controls.rationale: Same -iUDP/-sTCP:LISTEN contradiction; awk prints the command column, not the PID or address.

controls.request: kill whatever is running on port 8080
controls.rationale: lsof -iTCP:8080 without -sTCP:LISTEN also selects established connections, and the header token is passed to kill.

controls.request: do i have node installed
controls.command: if [[ -z $(which node) ]]; then echo "no"; else echo "yes"; fi
controls.rationale: The if/which test answers the question correctly on this shell; the historical incorrect expectation is unsupported.

controls.request: can I reach google.com? just try a few times
controls.rationale: No retry; a single request cannot satisfy "try a few times".

controls.request: put all the jpgs in this folder into a new folder called photos
controls.command: mkdir -p photos && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.jpg' -exec mv {} photos/ +
controls.rationale: Same invalid -exec + form; verified that nothing is moved.

controls.request: how big is the project folder in total
controls.rationale: Same invented project_folder operand.

controls.request: list apps in /Applications with chrome in the name
controls.rationale: Matches every path containing Chrome, including non-app files and helpers, and is case-sensitive.

controls.request: find the 10 biggest files inside Documents
controls.rationale: du -s on the glob reports per-entry totals including directories, so the ranking is not the biggest files.

controls.request: Which processes have UDP sockets open? Give numeric addresses.
controls.rationale: Same -iUDP/-sTCP:LISTEN contradiction; awk prints the command column.

controls.request: put all the jpgs in this folder into a new folder called photos
controls.command: mkdir -p photos && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.jpg' -exec mv -- {} photos/ +
controls.rationale: BSD find rejects -exec ... {} photos/ + because {} is not the last argument before + (verified).

controls.request: show notes.txt in all caps
controls.rationale: Command substitution collapses line breaks, so the output is not notes.txt in caps.

controls.request: kill whatever is running on port 8080
controls.rationale: Same over-broad lsof selection without the LISTEN restriction; the header token is passed to kill.

controls.request: Which processes have UDP sockets open? Give numeric addresses.
controls.rationale: Combines -iUDP with -sTCP:LISTEN, which cannot match UDP; the awk also reads the FD column, not the address field.

controls.request: copy report.pdf into my downloads folder
controls.rationale: Copies into ~/Downloads/report, an unrequested subfolder, instead of ~/Downloads.

controls.request: what's eating the space in my Downloads folder? biggest first
controls.rationale: "Downloads" is relative to the working directory, not the user's ~/Downloads.

controls.request: show notes.txt in all caps
controls.rationale: Prints the literal text "SHOW NOTES.TXT", not the file contents.

controls.request: i need a copy of the whole project folder called project-copy
controls.rationale: With the destination directory pre-created, cp -R nests project inside project-copy (verified).

controls.request: take a screenshot and save it as shot.png
controls.rationale: -c forces the capture to the clipboard, so shot.png is not saved.

controls.request: kill whatever is running on port 8080
controls.rationale: Same lsof selection; +M changes portmapper handling, not the over-broad process set.

controls.request: kill whatever is running on port 8080
controls.rationale: Filters column six for TCP, but TYPE is column five, so nothing is printed and nothing is killed.

controls.request: can I reach google.com? just try a few times
controls.rationale: No retry; the request asks to try a few times.

controls.request: list my running python processes
controls.rationale: ps -axo pid= prints PIDs only, so grep python never matches.

controls.request: how big is the project folder in total
controls.rationale: The request does not name project_folder; the operand is invented rather than derived.

controls.request: Print only field three from colon-delimited input.txt.
controls.rationale: cut -d: -f3 prints only field three; the useless cat is harmless.

controls.request: Count lines in notes.txt containing TODO, case-insensitively, as a literal string.
controls.rationale: Same as ct0061; option order only.

controls.request: top 5 processes by memory
controls.rationale: sorts the numeric memory column descending; the non-numeric header sorts last, so top five are processes.

controls.request: today's date as YYYY-MM-DD
controls.rationale: date +%Y-%m-%d prints today in that format.

controls.request: Test whether PID 1234 exists without sending it a real signal.
controls.command: ps -p 1234 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Process exists" || echo "Process does not exist"
controls.rationale: ps -p returns success iff the PID exists; no signal is sent.

controls.request: Print the Ethernet hardware address for interface en0.
controls.rationale: The -Eo pattern extracts exactly the ether address from en0 (verified against this Mac).

controls.request: hey how do I see what power source I'm on and the battery percent
controls.rationale: system_profiler SPPowerDataType reports the power source and battery charge.

controls.request: Read the CFBundleIdentifier string from MyApp.app's Info.plist.
controls.rationale: Print :CFBundleIdentifier reads the nested key correctly.

controls.request: show the first 20 lines of app.log
controls.rationale: tail -n +1 | head -n 20 prints the first 20 lines.

controls.request: Count lines in notes.txt containing TODO, case-insensitively, as a literal string.
controls.rationale: Same as ct0061; -E does not change a literal pattern.

controls.request: what is my public ip
controls.rationale: checkip.dyndns.org responded on this Mac; the pattern extracts the address.

controls.request: Print lines 3 through 7 of notes.txt, without changing it.
controls.rationale: head -n 7 piped into tail -n +3 prints lines 3 through 7 and does not modify the file.

controls.request: What path would this zsh session use if I typed python3?
controls.rationale: zsh which reports the path the session would use for python3.

controls.request: top 5 processes by memory
controls.rationale: sorts the numeric rss column descending; the header sorts last, so top five are processes.

controls.request: what is my public ip
controls.rationale: checkip.dyndns.org responded; stripping letters and punctuation leaves the address digits.

controls.request: Print that Info.plist as JSON, without rewriting it.
controls.rationale: plutil -convert json -o - writes JSON to stdout and leaves the plist untouched.

controls.request: Count lines in notes.txt containing TODO, case-insensitively, as a literal string.
controls.rationale: grep -ci counts matching lines case-insensitively for a literal string; no regex metacharacters in TODO.

controls.request: Show the macOS filesystem flags on report.pdf.
controls.rationale: stat %Sf prints the filesystem flags field (verified; prints "-" on this filesystem).

controls.request: Show the currently mounted volumes whose mount point is under /Volumes/.
controls.rationale: On macOS mount, field three is the mount point (verified); the awk filters /Volumes/.

controls.request: Rotate photo.jpg clockwise 90 degrees into rotated.jpg, preserving the source.
controls.rationale: sips --rotate 90 writes the rotated image to --out; the source is preserved.
